metadata.scope: Mapped above-water land in the Paracel Islands, plus seven PRC-administered Spratly reef outposts; this is not a boundary or sovereignty-claim polygon.
metadata.exclusions: Submerged reef flats, open sea, administrative claim lines, Taiwan-administered Taiping and other parties' occupied land are not terrain masks.
